summary: Comprehensive testing of User Status System and Pending Reports features. All backend APIs (19/19 tests) and frontend UI components working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BACKEND API Tests (19/19 passed):
- PUT /api/chat/my-status: Sets status to online/away/dnd/offline correctly
- PUT /api/chat/my-status with invalid value: Returns 400 as expected
- GET /api/chat/my-status: Returns current status with focus-time override
- POST /api/chat/statuses: Bulk fetch statuses for multiple users works
- GET /api/news/reports/pending-count: Admin gets count, non-reviewer gets 0 (not 403)
- All endpoints require authentication (401/403 without auth)
FRONTEND UI Tests (all passed):
- Dashboard: pending-reports-widget visible for admin with 2 open reports
- Dashboard: Widget shows 'MODERATION ERFORDERLICH' and '2 offene Meldungen'
- Dashboard: Clicking widget navigates to /admin
- Sidebar: status-picker-trigger visible with current status label
- Sidebar: Status picker menu opens with all 4 options (Online, Abwesend, Nicht stoeren, Offline)
- Sidebar: Status change via picker updates label (tested Online -> Abwesend)
- Sidebar: Admin badge shows '2' for pending reports
NewsPage Tests:
- 'ANGEPINNT' section header visible when pinned posts exist
- 'NEUESTE' section header visible below pinned posts
- News editor dialog opens with all fields (title, content, priority, switches)
- Visual separator between pinned and latest posts working
ChatPage Tests:
- Conversation list loads with StatusDot indicators
- DND banner 'Nicht stoeren aktiv' visible (admin has active focus)
- Chat area, input, send button all functional
- StatusDot shows gray hollow circles for offline users
AdminPage Tests:
- News-Moderation tab accessible
- Reports panel with filter buttons (Alle, Offen, Bearbeitet, Verworfen)
- Report actions (Als bearbeitet markieren, Verwerfen) visible
- Sidebar reports badge shows correct count (2)
Focus-Time Override Behavior (as designed):
- Admin has active Focus #7 until 19:11
- Status is forced to 'dnd' (Nicht stoeren) due to focus time
- Manual status change to 'away' works but focus override takes precedence
- This is expected behavior per the spec
context_for_next_testing_agent: User Status System fully implemented: (1) PUT/GET /api/chat/my-status for manual status changes; (2) POST /api/chat/statuses for bulk status fetch; (3) GET /api/news/reports/pending-count returns count for reviewers, 0 for others; (4) StatusPicker component in sidebar with 4 status options; (5) StatusDot component shows colored dots (online=green, away=beige, dnd=red, offline=gray ring); (6) pending-reports-widget on dashboard for admins; (7) Focus-time override forces status to 'dnd' when active. Admin currently has active focus time 'Focus #7' which overrides manual status to 'dnd'.

backend_status_endpoints.put_my_status: Sets status_mode to online/away/dnd/offline, returns 400 for invalid
backend_status_endpoints.get_my_status: Returns current status with focus-time override
backend_status_endpoints.post_statuses: Bulk fetch statuses for user_ids list

frontend_news_sections.pinned_header: 'ANGEPINNT' section header when pinned posts exist

frontend_chat_status.dnd_banner: data-testid='chat-dnd-banner' shows when user is in DND mode
